signature_mechanics: Heat Infliction generation and absorption, Twilight flaming transformation

normal_attack.name: Twilight Blade Combo
normal_attack.description: 5-stage continuous sword strike infusing blade with flame arts on terminal strike.

battle_skill.name: Molten Thrust
battle_skill.description: Forward dash delivering an upward flame crescent, inflicting Heat status on targets.

combo_skill.name: Cinder Surge
combo_skill.description: Triggered on stagger or elemental reaction. Slams ground releasing cascading volcanic eruption.

ultimate_skill.name: Twilight Awakening: Incineration
ultimate_skill.description: Summons the towering Twilight flaming familiar, replacing normal strings with massive fiery cleaves and granting complete stagger immunity.

passive_talent.name: Heat Assimilation
passive_talent.description: Absorbs ambient Heat Inflictions on hit to empower next skill strike with amplified critical damage.
